items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes math results from an unreleased internal model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公開未發布內部模型產出的數學成果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 it is releasing a broad set of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model, published on GitHub with revision and citation protocols and Lean formalizations of many proofs. It said the average result used roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro-equivalent thinking, and that it is consulting the Institute for Advanced Study’s Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI. Sam Altman amplified the post on Oct. 7, calling it a new era of discovery. The model itself is not released.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 6 日表示，正公開由內部前沿模型產出的一批新數學成果，放在 GitHub，並附修訂與引用規範，以及多項證明的 Lean 形式化。官方稱平均每項成果約等同 ChatGPT Pro 思考三小時，並已諮詢普林斯頓高等研究院數學與 AI 諮詢小組。Sam Altman 於 10 月 7 日轉發，稱進入發現的新時代。該模型本身尚未發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a disclosure of results, not a model launch: verification still depends on Lean coverage and community review, and OpenAI itself says unreleased capability is being held back for responsible release. The open question is how many claims survive formalization.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是成果披露而非模型發布：可驗證程度仍取決於 Lean 覆蓋與社群審查，OpenAI 也明說能力模型尚未負責任釋出。關鍵不確定是有多少主張能通過形式化。
items_flat.quote: We’re releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在發布由一個內部前沿模型產出的一系列新數學成果。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral opens a public preview of Mistral Large 4, ‘Le Chonk’
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on Oct. 6: a natively multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and 49 billion active, trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its European data centers. Weights are planned by the end of the month after red-teaming with cybersecurity partners and authorities. On Oct. 7 Mistral highlighted agent and legal-benchmark claims, including a lead among open-source models on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 於 10 月 6 日公開預覽 Mistral Large 4：原生多模態、1 兆參數、每次啟用 490 億，在歐洲自有資料中心以 3,800 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 從零訓練。權重預計月底釋出，此前先與資安夥伴及政府機構紅隊測試。10 月 7 日官方再強調代理與法律基準表現，包括在 Harvey Legal Agent Benchmark 的開源模型領先。
items_flat.analysis_en: The sovereignty pitch is concrete—European training and a promised open-weight drop—but the weights are not out, and several headline cyber scores reflect refusals by closed models rather than a settled ranking. Treat the Oct. 27-style window as a plan, not a shipped release.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 主權敘事有具體內容：歐洲訓練與承諾開放權重，但權重尚未釋出，部分資安高分也來自閉源模型拒答而非已定排名。月底釋出仍是計畫，不是已交付。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4. Unofficially ML4, very officially: le Chonk. Weights drop end of this month.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 的公開預覽。非正式簡稱 ML4，正式暱稱 le Chonk。權重將於本月底釋出。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路驗證計畫擴成三個層級
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct. 6 Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that gives qualifying security professionals advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers. The program now has three access tiers and includes Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Mythos 5.1, and future models. Anthropic said Project Glasswing partners uncovered at least 129,000 verified software vulnerabilities between April and July 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 10 月 6 日推出擴大版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的資安專業人員使用進階網路能力並降低阻擋分類器。計畫分為三個存取層級，涵蓋 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 及後續模型。官方稱 Glasswing 夥伴在 2026 年 4 至 7 月至少發現 129,000 個已驗證軟體漏洞。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is gated defender access, not a public jailbreak of safeguards. The practical effect depends on who qualifies and how often reduced classifiers still block legitimate testing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對防禦方的閘控存取，不是對公眾解除安全限制。實際影響取決於誰能通過審核，以及降低後的分類器仍會擋下多少合法測試。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出擴大版網路驗證計畫（CVP），讓符合資格的資安專業人員取得進階網路能力，並降低阻擋分類器。

items_flat.title_en: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone
items_flat.title_zh: Google 向所有人開放 SynthID Detector
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said on Oct. 7 that SynthID Detector is now available globally in English, expanding a tool previously aimed at media professionals. Users can check image, video, or audio for SynthID watermarks from Google and partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Kakao, with Apple listed as coming soon. Google said it has watermarked over 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 10 月 7 日宣布 SynthID Detector 以英文向全球開放，從原先面向媒體專業人士擴大。使用者可檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否帶有 Google 及合作方（含 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Kakao）的 SynthID 浮水印，Apple 列為即將支援。Google 稱已為逾 1,800 億張圖片與影片、以及 24 萬年音訊加上浮水印。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public detection only works on content that participating labs actually watermarked, so absence of a mark is not proof of human authorship. Cross-lab coverage is the useful change; English-only global access is the current limit.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開偵測只對有參與浮水印的實驗室內容有效，沒有標記不能證明是人拍的。跨實驗室覆蓋是實質進展；目前限制是全球僅英文。
items_flat.quote: Now, we’re expanding access to everyone – with the tool available globally in English starting today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在我們把存取擴大到所有人——此工具即日起以英文在全球提供。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedder
items_flat.title_zh: Google 釋出開放權重的 EmbeddingGemma 2 多模態嵌入模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google on Oct. 6 launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model under Apache 2.0, built on the Gemma 4 architecture. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one embedding space for on-device retrieval. Google said it improves MTEB Code by 9.92 points versus EmbeddingGemma, from 68.76 to 78.68.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 10 月 6 日推出 EmbeddingGemma 2：7.4 億參數、Apache 2.0、基於 Gemma 4 架構，把文字、程式碼、圖片、影片與音訊映到同一嵌入空間，供裝置端檢索。官方稱相對 EmbeddingGemma，MTEB Code 提升 9.92 分，由 68.76 到 78.68。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small open embedder, not a frontier chat model. Its value is local multimodal search; the size-class leader claim is Google’s, not an independent leaderboard result.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型開放嵌入模型，不是前沿對話模型。價值在本機多模態搜尋；同級領先是 Google 自述，不是獨立榜單結論。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到把程式碼、圖片、影片與音訊統一到同一個嵌入空間。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details computer-use research with Ironclad
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布與 Ironclad 的電腦操作研究合作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 that a research collaboration with contracting firm Ironclad is being used to train and evaluate agents on professional computer-use tasks. It said GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks, scoring 55.0% versus 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol across 11 internal research tasks, with estimated time per attempt falling from 37.0 to 19.2 minutes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 6 日表示，與合約軟體公司 Ironclad 的研究合作用於訓練與評估代理在專業電腦操作任務上的表現。官方稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型，11 項內部研究任務平均 55.0%，高於 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 41.6%，每次嘗試估計時間由 37.0 分鐘降至 19.2 分鐘。
items_flat.analysis_en: The numbers are an internal research eval, not a public benchmark. They show OpenAI treating contract workflows as training signal for computer use, not a new product launch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些數字是內部研究評測，不是公開基準。意義是 OpenAI 把合約流程當電腦操作的訓練訊號，不是新產品發布。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。
